name: taxappeal-qualify
description: ClaimOS Qualify step: decides which Find candidates to pursue, by which filing route, and in what order

scripts.demo: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('out/demo-results.json',{force:true})" && tsx scripts/make-sample-data.ts && tsx src/cli.ts run --candidates data/candidates.sample.json --config config/desk.placeholder.json --suppression data/suppression.sample.json --today 2026-11-05 --llm mock --out out/demo-results.json --audit out/demo-audit.jsonl && tsx src/cli.ts cases --results out/demo-results.json --candidates data/candidates.sample.json --config config/desk.placeholder.json --export out/demo-cases.json
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run demo
